The name Tammy has a rich history, particularly in the Bible, where it is associated with fertility, nurturing, and protection. In the New Testament, there is a woman named Tabitha, which is a Greek form of the name Tammy. Tabitha was known for her good works and kindness towards others. In addition, the name Tammy is believed to have a strong connection to the earth and nature.
